questions.q:
For the four-sentence (S1 to S4) paragraph below, sentences S1 and S4 are given. From the options P, Q, R and S select the appropriate sentences for S2 and S3, respectively.
S1: The Centre has unveiled broader benefits for its employees in the new guaranteed pension scheme.
S2: ………………………………………
S3: ………………………………………
S4: Those covered under the current National Pension System will have a chance to shift to the UPS.
 
P: The Centre claims the UPS, to be implemented from April next year, will benefit 23 lakh employees.
Q: The minimum eligibility period for receipt of pension is 10 years.
R: The Unified Pension Scheme (UPS) is surely a political response to the growing nationwide demand to revert to the pre-2004 Old Pension Scheme (OPS)
S: Like pension, family pension is also payable upto and including for the day of death of the recipient.
questions.solution:
B) R and P
S1 introduces the Centre's unveiling of broader benefits in a new guaranteed pension scheme, implying the introduction of a specific scheme.
R follows logically by introducing the "Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)" and linking it as a political response to a national demand. This maintains thematic coherence with S1.
P follows by providing a specific detail about the UPS implementation, which makes sense before leading into S4 that mentions a chance to shift to the UPS.
The pronoun "those" in S4 needs a clear antecedent. P mentions the employees who will be affected by the UPS, making it the natural antecedent for "those" in S4.
S talks about family pension and the day of death of the recipient, which is not directly connected to the introduction of a new pension scheme mentioned in S1.
Q introduces a generic detail about pension eligibility that does not logically connect with the broader benefits or the new UPS being introduced

questions.q:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant (A) / in the Atchutapuram Special Economic Zone (SEZ) in Anakapalli district, (B) / Andhra Pradesh, are the worst industrial accident (C) / in the region in recent times. (D)
questions.solution:
C) 'are' के बदले 'is' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यहां Subject 'The blast' Singular है, अतः Verb भी Singular होनी चाहिए; जैसे— The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant is the worst industrial accident in the region in recent times.
'is' will be used instead of 'are' because the subject 'The blast' is singular, so the verb should also be singular; Like— The blast at pharma company Escientia’s plant is the worst industrial accident in the region in recent times.

questions.q:
Select the most appropriate pair of words to fill in the blanks.
The investigators launched a __________ to uncover how the company exploited a legal __________  to avoid paying taxes
questions.solution:
C) Probe, loophole
'Probe' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि "probe" का अर्थ होता है किसी घटना या मामले की गहन जांच करना। और 'loophole' का अर्थ है किसी नियम या कानून में छूट या खामी का फायदा उठाना, जिससे करों के भुगतान से बचा जा सके। जबकि 'Plug' का अर्थ छेद को भरना, 'Mitigation' का अर्थ कम करना, 'Monitor' का अर्थ निगरानी करना, 'Urgency' का अर्थ आपातकालीन स्थिति, 'Imperative' का अर्थ अनिवार्यता, और 'Temper' का अर्थ क्रोध या स्वभाव से है, जो इस संदर्भ में उपयुक्त नहीं हैं।
'Probe' should be used because it means to conduct a thorough investigation of an event or issue. 'Loophole' refers to a gap or flaw in a rule or law that allows someone to avoid paying taxes. Whereas 'Plug' means to fill a hole, 'Mitigation' means to reduce, 'Monitor' means to observe, 'Urgency' means an emergency situation, 'Imperative' means necessity, and 'Temper' refers to mood or anger, which don't fit in this context.

questions.q:
Comprehension:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.
From the moment of birth, every human being wants happiness and does not want suffering. Neither social conditioning nor education _____1____ ideology affect this. From the very core of our being, we simply desire ______2_____. I don’t know whether the universe, with its countless galaxies, stars and planets, _____3_____a deeper meaning or not, but at the very least, it is clear that we humans who live on this earth face the task of making a happy life for ourselves. Therefore, it is important to discover what will bring about the greatest degree of happiness. Every kind of happiness and suffering is either mental or physical. Of the two, it is the mind that ______4_____the greatest influence on most of us. Unless we are either gravely ill or _____5_____ basic necessities, our physical condition plays a secondary role in life. If the body is content, we virtually ignore it. The mind, however, registers every event, no matter how small. Hence we should devote our most serious efforts to bringing about mental peace.
Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
questions.solution:
D) Nor' का use होगा क्योंकि यह 'Neither' के साथ सही pair बनाता है। जब किसी sentence में 'Neither' का उपयोग किया जाता है, तो इसे negative रूप में दो विकल्पों को जोड़ने के लिए 'Nor' के साथ जोड़ा जाता है। इस sentence में, नकारात्मक रूप में 'Neither' के बाद दूसरा नकारात्मक विकल्प present करने के लिए 'Nor' सही है। 'Either' का use positive choices के लिए किया जाता है, जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 'With' एक preposition है, जो यहां appropriate नहीं है, और 'Or' का उपयोग तब होता है जब एक सकारात्मक विकल्प पेश किया जा रहा हो, जो यहां उपयुक्त नहीं है।
Nor' will be used because it correctly pairs with 'Neither.' When 'Neither' is used in a sentence, it is combined with 'Nor' to connect two negative options. In this sentence, 'Nor' is the correct answer to present the second negative option after 'Neither.' 'Either' is used for positive choices, which doesn't fit this context. 'With' is a preposition, which is not appropriate here, and 'Or' is used when presenting a positive option, which is not suitable in this case.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
questions.solution:
C) 'Has' का use होगा क्योंकि 'the universe' singular है और singular subject के लिए present tense में 'has' का use किया जाता है। passage में mention है कि 'universe' का deeper meaning हो सकता है या नहीं, और इसके लिए present tense उपयुक्त है। इसलिए 'has' यहाँ सही है। जबकि 'Was' past tense में है, जो इस context में सही नहीं है। 'Have' plural subject के साथ use होता है, और 'Having' verb के continuous form के रूप में यहाँ गलत है।
'Has' will be used because 'the universe' is a singular subject, and in the present tense, we use 'has' with singular subjects. The passage discusses whether the universe has a deeper meaning, making present tense appropriate. Therefore, 'has' is correct here. On the other hand, 'Was' is in the past tense, which does not fit this context. 'Have' is used with plural subjects, and 'Having' as a continuous form of the verb is incorrect here.
